spots.name: Hart Mountain National Antelope Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Hart Mountain Hot Springs
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Acty Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,136 m (7,008 ft).

spots.name: Deep Creek Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 8 m (25 ft) tall.

spots.name: Lookout Point
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Fisher Hot Springs
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.
